securityCheck.aiSummary: No obfuscated code, no remote code execution, and no credential theft patterns beyond standard OAuth token usage. The main security concerns are (1) data exfiltration via external analytics (GoatCounter) that could leak user/tenant data, and (2) token handling in a browser context which could be exposed via XSS. The code aligns with expected Intune/Graph API usage but should address telemetry privacy and hardening of token handling in a SPA.
